claimed_invariant: Escaped Display newline controls create rows only outside raw Creole URL, math, and LaTeX blocks. Raw block bytes reach their domain parser intact. In particular, a literal backslash-n inside a URL remains in href and is normalized only when producing the SVG title.
causal_divergence: Rust has a correct raw-mode scanner only in the state transition model. Sequence measurement/emission, class note parsing, and class member rendering independently split on every literal backslash-n first. The shared Creole parser therefore receives a truncated `[[...]]` token in those families, even though its direct unit path handles the complete token correctly.
planned_model_change: Extract a parser-level raw-aware Display newline splitter from the existing state model. Use it in sequence Display row measurement/emission, class note parsing, and class member rendering. Keep the raw token unchanged; hyperlink parsing and title normalization remain separate downstream responsibilities. Add parser, sequence, and class tests with renamed labels and controls both inside and outside raw blocks.
perturbation_axes: sequence message labels versus class member labels

URL raw blocks versus math and LaTeX raw blocks
